c5de884d3fb6820c: Lost City, Mill on a Hill
84611f0cade5adab: A regional spatial strategy for Gouda and the Plaswijck neighbourhood, with a time horizon of fifty years. In a design team of nine roles I took on the role of regional planner, together with the Energy Transition theme group. A policy analysis, an analysis of existing structures and a SWOT analysis led to five ambitions: distributing residual heat from industry through a heat network across Gouda, making use of its position in the (high-quality) public transport network, using marginal farmland and water for sustainable energy, letting Gouda lead the energy transition, and letting new energy landscapes contribute to the liveability and identity of the landscape. These ambitions were worked out in vision maps for the region and the city, in the project solar and wind on land on rewetted peat, in sections of the spatial integration and in a phasing plan up to 2056.
